annotation.title_clean: Trialling automated vehicle technologies in public
annotation.title_en: Trialling automated vehicle technologies in public
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Centre for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles; Department for Science, Innovation and Technology; Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy
annotation.summary_en: UK government landing page for guidance on safely trialling automated vehicles on public roads. It points to two codes of practice: one on conducting trials safely and engaging the public and authorities, and one on vehicle authorisations and exemptions for more complex trials. It also lists the update history.
key_provisions_or_claims: Automated vehicle trialling code of practice gives guidance on safe and responsible trials on public roads.
Recommends engaging the public, authorities and relevant bodies when planning trials.
Separate code covers vehicle authorisations and exemptions for more complex CAV trials.
June 2026 update clarifies safety driver requirements.
2023 update added MOT requirements, GB type approval, and STGO scope.
